items.title: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model, and our remediation with SGLang
items.summary: A configuration mismatch in GLM 5.3 on Workers AI triggered an SGLang bug that exposed KV cache pages across requests. Here is how we addressed the issue.

items.title: Origin Range Requests: Serving large files without range-request tuning
items.summary: Naive byte-range caching can waste gigabytes of origin bandwidth on small requests. We rebuilt our cache architecture in Pingora to coordinate partial fetches automatically, cutting R2 p99 latency in half.

items.title: Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management
items.summary: Cloudflare's new post-quantum GeoKey Manager protects geographically fenced decryption keys from harvest now, decrypt later attacks. Learn how we redesigned our cryptography stack to support strict data sovereignty in a post-quantum world.

items.title: Localizing compliance at scale: achieving South Korea’s ISMS certification
items.summary: Cloudflare has achieved South Korea's ISMS certification following an audit across 80 controls. Learn how we localized user consent flows, adapted social sign-up paths at the edge, and validated our global security program.

items.title: Introducing full transaction detection for Cloudflare WAF
items.summary: Cloudflare's web application firewall can now correlate an HTTP request with its response. Full transaction detection helps every customer find successful exploits, data exposure, and risky misconfigurations that request-only inspection can miss.

items.title: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability
items.summary: Cloudflare has deployed default web application firewall (WAF) protections for newly disclosed PHP vulnerabilities before public disclosure. The rules use request and response signals to stop exploit attempts and prevent exposed data from reaching attackers.

items.title: How Commerce.com and Cloudflare are getting storefronts ready for AI agents
items.summary: Almost 100,000 Commerce.com domains now give AI agents real shopping tools through WebMCP on Cloudflare. Here's how we turned it on across every store at once, while keeping each merchant in control.

items.title: 8 eMudhra certificates are compromised. Here's what you need to know
items.summary: Following the discovery that eight eMudhra intermediate certificates use weak keys, Cloudflare is deploying mitigations and releasing client updates. We explain the impact, our response, and what customers and developers should do next.

items.title: Introducing tsrs: A port of TypeScript to Rust
items.summary: Cloudflare is collaborating on tsrs, a Rust port of TypeScript that is up to 8x faster and uses 70% less memory.

items.title: Cutting our inference bill by 68% by being obsessive about optimization
items.summary: When our AI code reviewer's cost per run doubled, we dug into the token usage to find out why. Learn how we used prompt caching and intelligent model routing to slash our inference bill by 68% while speeding up reviews.

items.title: Introducing Clairic, a new System One class of extraction models
items.summary: Clairic is a new model from Cloudflare that is a System One extraction modeI, capable of extracting, computing, estimating, and forecasting data from unstructured inputs.

items.title: Beyond the patch: Protecting your NetScaler gateway against future vulnerabilities
items.summary: CVE-2026-88771 lets attackers run commands on NetScaler Gateway before anyone signs in. Patching takes time most teams don't have, so the sign-in decision has to move in front of the vulnerable code.

items.title: Continuous accountability for Verified bots
items.summary: Identity alone doesn't guarantee a bot will behave responsibly. We are introducing a system to continuously evaluate whether Verified bots honor site preferences, like robots.txt and HTTP 429s, ensuring they remain accountable over time.

items.title: A fully programmable secure web gateway
items.summary: Cloudflare Gateway and Data Loss Prevention have inherited the flexibility and power of Cloudflare Workers through our full-stack integration with the Cloudflare Developer platform.

items.title: Deploy with Void
items.summary: Introducing Void: an open-source SDK, CLI, and self-hosted platform for building full-stack Vite apps and deploying them to Cloudflare.

items.title: Cloudflare and OpenAI: Making AI discovery better for everyone
items.summary: How Cloudflare and OpenAI are working together to help AI find useful content, keep up with changes, and make fewer wasted requests — making the experience better for users and website owners alike.

items.title: Yandex outage: Data shows that instead of going dark, malicious bots went on the move
items.summary: When strikes hit Yandex data centers, many assumed Russian bot operations went dark. Cloudflare data reveals that while search crawling stopped, malicious bots simply migrated to other networks.

items.title: Inside Hyperdrive: How we solved a rare Hyperdrive MySQL caching bug
items.summary: While adding MySQL support to Hyperdrive, we found a subtle protocol bug when caching query results. Here is how we tracked down a 0.001% rate error and made Hyperdrive MySQL generally available.

items.title: Under the hood, off the hot path: How D1 scales to millions of databases
items.summary: A deep dive into how D1 architected its control plane to scale and manage millions of databases, while keeping data plane query operations at the edge. We share guiding principles on how to build on the Developer Platform effectively.

items.title: Rewinding the exponential: How we keep hardware usage down
items.summary: Our strategies to optimize our data pipeline throughput without compromising data quality.
